SELECT
    s.sector_name_zh AS 行业名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 贷款笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 不良笔数,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) * 1.0
        / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id), 6
    ) AS 不良笔数占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector s ON op.industry_code = s.sector_code
LEFT JOIN risk_classification rc
    ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
GROUP BY s.sector_code, s.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 不良笔数占比 DESC;

    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS restricted_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 6) AS ratio

JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id

GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

LEFT JOIN payment_type_catalog pt ON p.payment_type = pt.payment_type
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
  AND p.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY p.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ind_borrower.sector_name_zh AS 借款人注册行业名称,
    ind_target.sector_name_zh AS 协议投向行业名称,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind_borrower ON op.industry_code = ind_borrower.sector_code
JOIN industry_sector ind_target ON ca.target_industry_code = ind_target.sector_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code <> op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.payment_id,
    p.business_date,
    p.amount,
    ah_from.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    ah_to.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event p
JOIN account_holder ah_from 
    ON p.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder ah_to 
    ON p.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
WHERE p.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM party_relation pr
      WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
        AND (
            (pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id)
            OR
            (pr.source_party_id = ah_to.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_from.party_id)
        )
  )
ORDER BY p.amount DESC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(*) AS 笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event p
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1 AND p.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT sm.staff_id AS 员工工号, COUNT(*) AS 笔数
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN account acc ON pe.to_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 笔数 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    d.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    d.event_date,
    d.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(d.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 d
JOIN institution i ON d.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE d.completion_date IS NULL
  AND d.deadline_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT sa.security_id, ca.collateral_id, ca.status AS collateral_status, sa.status AS security_status
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE ca.status = 'RELEASED' AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT l.loan_id AS 借据编号,
       l.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
       sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
       sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE l.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT institution_name, loan_id, principal_balance, rn AS balance_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
loan_industry AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        COALESCE(op.industry_code, 'OTHER') AS industry_code
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN latest_balance lb ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        li.industry_code,
        li.loan_id,
        li.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY li.industry_code ORDER BY li.principal_balance DESC, li.loan_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM loan_industry li
)
SELECT
    isec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    r.loan_id,
    ROUND(r.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    r.rn AS industry_rank
FROM ranked r
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = r.industry_code
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY isec.sector_name_zh ASC, r.rn ASC;

SELECT 
    business_date AS 业务日期,
    COUNT(*) AS 当日笔数,
    COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS 较前一日的笔数变化
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date;

WITH balance AS (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
loan_inst AS (
    SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.agreement_id, ca.institution_id, b.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN balance b ON ld.loan_id = b.loan_id
),
inst_avg AS (
    SELECT institution_id, AVG(principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_inst
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name, li.loan_id, li.principal_balance, 
       ROUND(ia.avg_balance, 2) AS avg_balance,
       ROUND(li.principal_balance - ia.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_inst li
JOIN inst_avg ia ON li.institution_id = ia.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON li.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE li.principal_balance > ia.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 担保人数量
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM collateral_link cl 
    WHERE cl.security_id = sa.security_id
)
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'
    WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
    WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
    WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
    WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
    ELSE '360天以上'
  END AS overdue_range,
  COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot
WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY overdue_range
ORDER BY MIN(principal_overdue_days);

SELECT collateral_id, valued_on, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM collateral_valuation
GROUP BY collateral_id, valued_on
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY collateral_id ASC;

SELECT p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       COUNT(l.loan_id) AS 贷款笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / COUNT(l.loan_id), 2) AS 平均单笔金额
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 平均单笔金额 DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ou.unit_name AS 机构单元名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS 员工人数,
       COUNT(*) AS 经办笔数
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON sm.home_org_unit_id

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment AS 客户分层,
    COUNT(*) AS 客户数量,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS 平均年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 6) AS 高收入客户占比
FROM party p
LEFT JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH payment_base AS (
    SELECT
        p.payment_id,
        p.amount,
        COALESCE(fa.institution_id, ta.institution_id) AS institution_id,
        fh.party_id AS from_holder_party_id,
        th.party_id AS to_holder_party_id
    FROM payment_event p
    LEFT JOIN account fa ON fa.account_id = p.from_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account ta ON ta.account_id = p.to_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_holder fh
        ON fh.account_id = p.from_account_id
       AND fh.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    LEFT JOIN account_holder th
        ON th.account_id = p.to_account_id
       AND th.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
),
related_payment AS (
    SELECT
        pb.institution_id,
        pb.amount
    FROM payment_base pb
    WHERE pb.from_holder_party_id IS NOT NULL
      AND pb.to_holder_party_id IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM party_relation pr
          JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
            ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
          WHERE pr.source_party_id = pb.from_holder_party_id
            AND pr.target_party_id = pb.to_holder_party_id
            AND rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
      )
),
inst_total AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM payment_base
    WHERE institution_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
inst_related AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        SUM(amount) AS related_amount
    FROM related_payment
    WHERE institution_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ir.related_amount, 0), 2) AS related_amount,
    ROUND(it.total_amount, 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ir.related_amount, 0) * 1.0 / it.total_amount, 6) AS related_ratio
FROM inst_total it
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = it.institution_id
LEFT JOIN inst_related ir ON ir.institution_id = it.institution_id
ORDER BY related_ratio DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, 
       COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM party p
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = ah.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY term_deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS 平均账龄天数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 平均账龄天数 DESC;

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT
        lbs.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lbs.loan_id ORDER BY lbs.as_of_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date <= '2026-06-30'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM latest_balance
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
industry_balance AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(ins.sector_name_zh, '其他行业') AS industry_name,
        SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM latest_balance lb
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
    LEFT JOIN industry_sector ins ON ins.sector_code = op.industry_code
    GROUP BY COALESCE(ins.sector_name_zh, '其他行业')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC, industry_name ASC) AS cum_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER () AS grand_total
    FROM industry_balance
),
with_ratio AS (
    SELECT
        industry_name,
        ROUND(total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
        ROUND(cum_balance * 1.0 / grand_total, 6) AS cum_ratio
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT industry_name, total_balance, cum_ratio
FROM with_ratio
WHERE cum_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY cum_ratio ASC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(*) AS 未结清借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

WITH latest_val AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY collateral_id ORDER BY valued_on DESC) AS rn
    FROM collateral_valuation
)
SELECT sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount, lv.collateral_id, lv.valuation_amount
FROM latest_val lv
JOIN collateral_link cl ON lv.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE lv.rn = 1 AND lv.valuation_amount > 2 * sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY (lv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS 开户机构家数
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 开户机构家数 DESC;

SELECT from_account_id AS account_id,
       business_date AS transaction_date,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event
WHERE from_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_balance
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 担保人编号,
    p.display_name AS 担保人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.security_id) AS 担保合同数量,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 担保金额合计
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.security_id) > 1 AND SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) AS INTEGER) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(pi.instruction_amount, 2) AS instruction_amount,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款方名称,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND p.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    ind.sector_name_zh,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
JOIN industry_sector ind ON ca.target_industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE lpc.product_family = 'WORKING_CAPITAL'
  AND ind.risk_category = 'EXIT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
loan_inst AS (
    SELECT ld.loan_id,
           i.institution_id,
           i.institution_name
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
),
inst_avg AS (
    SELECT li.institution_id,
           AVG(lb.principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_inst li
    JOIN latest_balance lb ON li.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    GROUP BY li.institution_id
)
SELECT li.institution_name,
       li.loan_id,
       ROUND(lb.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
       ROUND(ia.avg_balance, 2) AS avg_balance,
       ROUND(lb.principal_balance - ia.avg_balance, 2) AS diff_amount
FROM loan_inst li
JOIN latest_balance lb ON li.loan_id = lb.loan_id
JOIN inst_avg ia ON li.institution_id = ia.institution_id
WHERE lb.principal_balance > 2 * ia.avg_balance
ORDER BY diff_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.source_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
    ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS non_related_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
            SELECT pr.source_party_id
            FROM party_relation pr
            WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
        ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ca.contract_amount),
        6
    ) AS ratio
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

WITH latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT lbs.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
borrower_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(llb.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN latest_loan_balance llb ON ld.loan_id = llb.loan_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT cs.institution_id, cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(bb.total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(lc.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(bb.total_balance * 1.0 / lc.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM borrower_balance bb
JOIN latest_capital lc ON bb.institution_id = lc.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON bb.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON bb.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE bb.total_balance * 1.0 / lc.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.target_industry_code AS industry_code,
        AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.target_industry_code
)
SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS annual_interest_rate,
    ROUND(ia.avg_rate, 4) AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 1.0 / ia.avg_rate * 100, 2) AS premium_pct
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_avg ia ON ia.industry_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ia.avg_rate > 0
  AND (ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 1.0 / ia.avg_rate > 0.10
ORDER BY premium_pct DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
customer_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN latest_loan_balance lb ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT cs.institution_id, cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS over_limit_customer_count
FROM customer_exposure ce
JOIN latest_capital lc ON ce.institution_id = lc.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON ce.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lc.net_capital > 0
  AND ce.total_principal * 1.0 / lc.net_capital > 0.10
GROUP BY ce.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY over_limit_customer_count DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    ROUND(SUM(lb.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(lb.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS 占比
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb
    ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(lb.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    pe.payment_id AS 转账流水号,
    pe.business_date AS 转账日期,
    ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS 转账金额,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS 间隔天数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON pe.from_account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursement_account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
  AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
ORDER BY 间隔天数 ASC, 转账金额 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

WITH latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT institution_id, net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
customer_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN latest_loan_balance lb ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
ratio_calc AS (
    SELECT
        ce.institution_id,
        ce.borrower_party_id,
        ROUND(ce.total_principal * 1.0 / lc.net_capital, 6) AS ratio
    FROM customer_exposure ce
    JOIN latest_capital lc ON ce.institution_id = lc.institution_id
    WHERE lc.net_capital > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        borrower_party_id,
        ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY ratio DESC) AS rn
    FROM ratio_calc
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    r.ratio
FROM ranked r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON r.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT
        lbs.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ca.institution_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lbs.loan_id ORDER BY lbs.as_of_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date <= '2026-06-30'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        institution_id,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
    FROM latest_balance
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    quartile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
loan_inst AS (
    SELECT ld.loan_id, ca.institution_id, i.institution_name
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
),
inst_total AS (
    SELECT li.institution_id, SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS inst_total_balance
    FROM latest_balance lb
    JOIN loan_inst li ON lb.loan_id = li.loan_id
    GROUP BY li.institution_id
)
SELECT
    li.loan_id,
    li.institution_name,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance * 1.0 / it.inst_total_balance * 100, 2) AS pct
FROM latest_balance lb
JOIN loan_inst li ON lb.loan_id = li.loan_id
JOIN inst_total it ON li.institution_id = it.institution_id
ORDER BY li.institution_name ASC, pct DESC, li.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS loan_id,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.status AS status,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC, total_overdue_principal DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    loan_account_id AS 放款账户编号,
    disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    COUNT(loan_id) AS 放款借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY loan_account_id, disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 放款借据笔数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT p.party_id
FROM party p
WHERE p.party_id IN (
    SELECT ah.party_id
    FROM account_holder ah
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
    JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
)
AND p.party_id IN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
)
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT sm.person_party_id AS party_id
FROM staff_member sm
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.party_id = sm.person_party_id
  )
ORDER BY sm.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM payment_event pe
      WHERE pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
        AND pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS maturity_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY CASE maturity_bucket
    WHEN '常态' THEN 1
    WHEN '临期' THEN 2
    WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
END;

SELECT cl.collateral_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS related_security_count
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) > 1
ORDER BY related_security_count DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_type AS 押品种类,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS 平均评估价值,
    COUNT(*) AS 评估笔数
FROM collateral_valuation cv
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY 平均评估价值 DESC;

WITH loan_repay_account AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.repayment_account_id AS repay_account_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
account_loan_count AS (
    SELECT
        repay_account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loan_cnt
    FROM loan_repay_account
    GROUP BY repay_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) >= 3
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        lra.repay_account_id,
        lra.loan_id,
        lra.disbursed_on,
        lra.disbursed_amount,
        alc.loan_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lra.repay_account_id
            ORDER BY lra.disbursed_on ASC, lra.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_repay_account lra
    JOIN account_loan_count alc
        ON lra.repay_account_id = alc.repay_account_id
)
SELECT
    repay_account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    ROUND(disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    loan_cnt
FROM ranked_loans
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repay_account_id ASC, disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 合同金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 累计放款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 超合同投放金额,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 放款笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance), 2) AS total_difference
FROM account_balance_snapshot abs
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND abs.available_balance IS NOT NULL
  AND abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
  AND (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_difference DESC;

SELECT
    td.account_id,
    ROUND(td.opening_principal, 2) AS opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    ROUND(td.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT
    pc.card_id,
    pc.card_type,
    pc.issued_on
FROM payment_card pc
WHERE pc.card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND pc.issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY pc.issued_on ASC, pc.card_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS entrusted_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS self_amount,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6
    ) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6
) < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ld.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS 单笔放款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) > 0.9
ORDER BY ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(w.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS actual_raise_total,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN w.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS planned_raise_total,
    ROUND(SUM(w.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN w.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 6) AS completion_rate
FROM wealth_product w
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = w.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(w.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN w.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 借款人编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 逾期借据笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 全部借据笔数
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status <> 'OVERDUE' OR rs.status IS NULL THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
ORDER BY 逾期借据笔数 DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    ROUND(pi.instruction_amount, 2) AS instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id <> ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.signed_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS unsettled_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER BY total_principal_due DESC, rs.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 期末剩余本金,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS 期末逾期本金
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.security_type,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    p.display_name
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT source_party_id AS party_id
    FROM party_relation
    WHERE relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT target_party_id AS party_id
    FROM party_relation
    WHERE relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
),
agreement_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
)
SELECT
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS annual_interest_rate,
    ROUND(aa.avg_rate, 4) AS avg_rate,
    ROUND(aa.avg_rate - ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS rate_spread
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN related_borrowers rb ON rb.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN agreement_avg aa
    ON aa.institution_id = ca.institution_id
   AND aa.product_family = ca.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.annual_interest_rate < aa.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    pr.source_party_id AS source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id AS target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh AS relation_name_zh
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement ca
      JOIN loan_drawdown ld
          ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement ca
      JOIN loan_drawdown ld
          ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
  )
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh ASC, pr.relation_id ASC;

WITH member_loans AS (
    SELECT
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm
        ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca
        ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
        AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld
        ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
        ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
        AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
capital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    ml.group_name,
    ml.member_count,
    ROUND(ml.total_principal, 2) AS total_principal,
    ROUND(c.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(ml.total_principal * 1.0 / c.net_capital, 6) AS ratio
FROM member_loans ml
JOIN capital c
    ON c.institution_id = ml.institution_id
WHERE ml.member_count >= 2
  AND ml.total_principal * 1.0 / c.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer.display_name AS payer_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN party payer ON payer.party_id = ah_from.party_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = ah_to.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id
    AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY payer.display_name, payee.display_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    phs.product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT phs.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
WHERE phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
GROUP BY phs.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    lb.loan_id,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(MAX(d.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS max_overdue_days
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN delinquency_snapshot d
    ON d.loan_id = lb.loan_id
WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND d.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lb.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND d.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(d.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, lb.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
   AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(COALESCE(g.guarantee_total, 0), 2) AS 对外担保合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0), 2) AS 自身借款合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(g.guarantee_total, 0) - COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0), 2) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
JOIN (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS guarantee_total
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) g ON g.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS loan_total
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) l ON l.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND COALESCE(g.guarantee_total, 0) > COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0)
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT p.display_name AS employee_name,
       sm.staff_id AS staff_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY agreement_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    ROUND(pp.annual_income, 2) AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    so.operator_id AS 操作员编号,
    so.authority_level AS 权限级别,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
GROUP BY p.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS 放款金额,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'STAFF'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 个人年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS 应还本息总额,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, 借款人客户编号 ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    lpc.product_name_zh AS 产品类别名称,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS 逾期笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id AS loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    installment_no,
    ROUND(principal_due, 2) AS principal_due,
    ROUND(interest_due, 2) AS interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY principal_due DESC;

WITH facility_agg AS (
    SELECT institution_id, SUM(limit_amount) AS total_limit
    FROM credit_facility
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
drawdown_agg AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
capital AS (
    SELECT institution_id, net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(f.total_limit, 0), 2) AS total_limit,
    ROUND(COALESCE(d.total_disbursed, 0), 2) AS total_disbursed,
    ROUND(c.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(COALESCE(d.total_disbursed, 0) * 1.0 / c.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital c ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id
LEFT JOIN facility_agg f ON i.institution_id = f.institution_id
LEFT JOIN drawdown_agg d ON i.institution_id = d.institution_id
WHERE COALESCE(d.total_disbursed, 0) > c.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS 设定担保金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人个数,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
   AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    cf.facility_id,
    cf.limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh
FROM credit_facility cf
LEFT JOIN status_catalog sc
    ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement'
   AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_limit_amount
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY cf.institution_id, i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT facility_type AS 授信类型, COUNT(*) AS 记录数
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY 记录数 DESC;

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 记录数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc
    ON pmc.payment_mode = ld.payment_mode
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 记录数 DESC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        minimum_holding_days,
        actual_raise_amount,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS grp
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
)
SELECT
    grp AS group_no,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM ranked
WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
GROUP BY grp
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY grp ASC;

SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_revolving_limit,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS disbursement_count
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
GROUP BY cf.facility_id
ORDER BY total_revolving_limit DESC;

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc
    ON pmc.payment_mode = pi.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    itc.name_zh AS instrument_name_zh,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name_zh
FROM instrument_type_catalog itc
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY itc.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS 信贷客户经理人数
FROM staff_assignment sa
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
WHERE sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 信贷客户经理人数 DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    ROUND(ds.overdue_principal, 2)
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.loan_id) AS under_provisioned_loan_count
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = p.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND p.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
  AND p.required_amount > 0
  AND ROUND(p.recognized_amount * 1.0 / p.required_amount, 6) < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY under_provisioned_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY provision_gap DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    ROUND(ABS(b.ledger_balance), 2) AS ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot b
    ON b.account_id = a.account_id
   AND b.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account_holder h
      WHERE h.account_id = a.account_id
        AND h.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
  )
ORDER BY ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    ma.asset_category_primary AS asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN industry_sector ind ON ma.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE ind.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(pp.annual_income, 2) AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.obligor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, 客户编号 ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    occupation_code,
    employment_sector,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile
GROUP BY occupation_code, employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, occupation_code ASC, employment_sector ASC;

SELECT
    status AS card_status,
    COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, card_status ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC, 营业单元名称 ASC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    pc.card_id AS 银行卡编号,
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    pe.business_date AS 交易日期,
    ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS 交易金额
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pc.holder_party_id AS holder_party_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cash_txn_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS cash_txn_amount
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN account a
    ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON (pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id OR pe.to_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id)
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY cash_txn_count DESC, cash_txn_amount DESC;

SELECT
    holder_party_id AS holder_party_id,
    COUNT(card_id) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(card_id) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    ctc.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
GROUP BY ctc.name_zh
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, card_type_name ASC;

SELECT
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE status = 'SETTLED'
  AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY channel
HAVING AVG(amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, channel ASC;

SELECT
    td.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id AS 押品编号,
    ca.asset_label AS 押品标识,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS 被引用次数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS 关联担保合同数
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_link cl
    ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 被引用次数 DESC, ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ca.agreement_id AS agreement_id,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.commitment_id, gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, ca.agreement_id, gc.guaranteed_amount
HAVING gc.guaranteed_amount > SUM(ld.disbursed_amount)
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id AS borrower_party_id,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS total_covered_amount,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN security_agreement sa
    ON sa.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN secured_obligation so
    ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
    AND so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0) < ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS underprovisioned_loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY underprovisioned_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 贷款余额,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 授信金额,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 余额倍数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 0
  AND lbs.principal_balance >= 4 * ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 余额倍数 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.loan_id) AS 多计提笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount), 2) AS 多计提金额合计
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 多计提金额合计 DESC, 机构名称 ASC, 五级分类名称 ASC;

WITH internal_val AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_internal
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
),
external_val AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(iv.max_internal, 2) AS max_internal_value,
    ROUND(ev.max_external, 2) AS max_external_value,
    ROUND(iv.max_internal - ev.max_external, 2) AS undervaluation_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN internal_val iv ON ca.collateral_id = iv.collateral_id
JOIN external_val ev ON ca.collateral_id = ev.collateral_id
WHERE ev.max_external < iv.max_internal
ORDER BY undervaluation_gap DESC;

WITH latest_valuation AS (
    SELECT cv.collateral_id, cv.valuation_amount
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
    JOIN (
        SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valued_on) AS max_valued_on
        FROM collateral_valuation
        GROUP BY collateral_id
    ) lv ON cv.collateral_id = lv.collateral_id AND cv.valued_on = lv.max_valued_on
),
pledged AS (
    SELECT cl.collateral_id, SUM(cl.pledged_amount) AS total_pledged
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(lv.valuation_amount, 2) AS latest_valuation_amount,
    ROUND(p.total_pledged, 2) AS total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(p.total_pledged - lv.valuation_amount, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN latest_valuation lv ON ca.collateral_id = lv.collateral_id
JOIN pledged p ON ca.collateral_id = p.collateral_id
WHERE p.total_pledged > lv.valuation_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(borrow.borrow_amount, 0), 2) AS self_borrow_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(guar.guarantee_amount, 0), 2) AS external_guarantee_amount
FROM party p
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS borrow_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) borrow ON borrow.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) guar ON guar.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE guar.guarantee_amount > borrow.borrow_amount
ORDER BY external_guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    eg.group_type AS group_type_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, eg.group_type
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 成员客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, 成员客户编号 ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
    AND pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC;

SELECT p.party_id,
       p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr
  ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
 AND pr.relation_type = 'SHADOW_SHAREHOLDER'
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
  ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_s.agreement_id) AS source_agreement_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_t.agreement_id) AS target_agreement_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN credit_agreement ca_s
    ON ca_s.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca_t
    ON ca_t.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ca_s.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca_t.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ca.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset ca
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM collateral_link cl
      WHERE cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
        AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(gc.total_guaranteed, 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ld.total_loan, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(gc.total_guaranteed - COALESCE(ld.total_loan, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM (
    SELECT
        guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed
    FROM guarantor_commitment
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY guarantor_party_id
) gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
        ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
       AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) ld ON ld.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.total_guaranteed > COALESCE(ld.total_loan, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证金额,
    gc.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement ca
      JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
        AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
        AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
  )
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, p.party_id ASC;

WITH latest_holding AS (
    SELECT
        phs.product_id,
        phs.asset_id,
        phs.investment_path,
        phs.lookthrough_depth,
        phs.intermediary_party_id
    FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
    WHERE phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND phs.lookthrough_depth >= 2
),
asset_obligor AS (
    SELECT
        ma.asset_id,
        ma.asset_name,
        ma.obligor_party_id
    FROM managed_asset ma
    WHERE ma.obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
),
overdue_borrower AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ds.overdue_principal, 0)), 2) AS overdue_principal_total
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ds.overdue_principal > 0
      AND ca.borrower_party_id IN (
          SELECT p.party_id FROM party p WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
      )
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ao.asset_name,
    ao.obligor_party_id,
    ob.overdue_principal_total
FROM latest_holding lh
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = lh.product_id
JOIN asset_obligor ao ON ao.asset_id = lh.asset_id
JOIN overdue_borrower ob ON ob.party_id = ao.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, ob.overdue_principal_total DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_type AS security_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS security_count,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS total_covered_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY total_covered_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_holding_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND phs.fair_value IS NOT NULL
  AND phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY inversion_amount DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    ROUND(phs.carrying_amount, 2) AS carrying_amount,
    ROUND(od.overdue_principal_sum, 2) AS overdue_principal_sum
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        ca.institution_id AS institution_id,
        SUM(ds.overdue_principal) AS overdue_principal_sum
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca
        ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds
        ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
       AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id, ca.institution_id
) od
    ON od.party_id = ma.issuer_party_id
   AND od.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_lien_active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_60_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY over_60_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities, 2) AS total_liabilities,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
