    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM financial_snapshot fs
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = fs.party_id
JOIN institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND fs.total_assets <> 0
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS tier1_capital_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets <> 0
ORDER BY tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i
    ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || cs.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = cs.as_of_date
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.annual_revenue), 2) AS total_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.annual_revenue) * 1.0 / (
        SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue)
        FROM financial_snapshot fs2
        JOIN party p2 ON p2.party_id = fs2.party_id
        JOIN institution i2 ON p2.party_id = 'PTY-' || i2.institution_id
    ), 6) AS revenue_ratio
FROM financial_snapshot fs
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = fs.party_id
JOIN institution i ON p.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(fs.annual_revenue) * 1.0 / (
    SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue)
    FROM financial_snapshot fs2
    JOIN party p2 ON p2.party_id = fs2.party_id
    JOIN institution i2 ON p2.party_id = 'PTY-' || i2.institution_id
) > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i
    ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating <> ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'FIXED'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

WITH latest_provision AS (
    SELECT loan_id, required_amount, recognized_amount
    FROM provision_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
under_provision AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(lp.required_amount - lp.recognized_amount) AS under_amount
    FROM latest_provision lp
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lp.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lp.recognized_amount < lp.required_amount
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
latest_financial AS (
    SELECT party_id, net_assets
    FROM financial_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(up.under_amount, 2) AS under_provision_total,
    ROUND(lf.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND(up.under_amount * 1.0 / lf.net_assets, 2) AS under_provision_ratio
FROM under_provision up
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = up.institution_id
JOIN latest_financial lf ON lf.party_id = 'PTY-' || up.institution_id
WHERE lf.net_assets IS NOT NULL AND lf.net_assets <> 0
ORDER BY under_provision_ratio DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT
    ca.institution_id AS institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS nonperforming_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / fs.annual_revenue, 6) AS overdue_to_revenue_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || ca.institution_id
WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY ca.institution_id, fs.annual_revenue
HAVING SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / fs.annual_revenue > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_pct
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_pct DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY pending_instruction_count DESC, pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS exception_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pm.amount_value), 2) AS exception_amount,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(pm.amount_value) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital * 100, 4) AS pct_of_net_capital
FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pm
JOIN institution i
    ON i.institution_id = pm.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = pm.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || pm.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE pm.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY pm.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY pct_of_net_capital DESC;

WITH provision_shortfall AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ps.loan_id) AS shortfall_loan_count,
        ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS shortfall_amount
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
overdue_submission AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_record_count,
        ROUND(AVG(amount_value), 2) AS avg_amount
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3
    WHERE deadline_date < '2026-06-30'
      AND (completion_date IS NULL OR completion_date > deadline_date)
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    os.overdue_record_count,
    os.avg_amount,
    COALESCE(psf.shortfall_loan_count, 0) AS shortfall_loan_count,
    COALESCE(psf.shortfall_amount, 0.00) AS shortfall_amount
FROM overdue_submission os
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = os.institution_id
LEFT JOIN provision_shortfall psf ON psf.institution_id = os.institution_id
WHERE os.overdue_record_count >= 25
ORDER BY shortfall_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS facility_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN g.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(g.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_facility cf
    ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN governance_control_record_v3 g
    ON g.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY abnormal_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS 关联目标主体数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS 关系种类数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 非非关联方关系笔数
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = rtr.subject_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = rtr.subject_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联目标主体数 DESC, 关系种类数 DESC, 客户名称 ASC;

WITH card_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS holder_count
    FROM payment_card pc
    JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
op_risk_stats AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS valid_record_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount
    FROM operational_risk_event_v3
    WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 43
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(cs.valid_card_count, 0) AS valid_card_count,
    COALESCE(cs.holder_count, 0) AS holder_count,
    COALESCE(ors.exception_amount, 0) AS exception_amount,
    ors.valid_record_count
FROM op_risk_stats ors
JOIN institution i ON ors.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN card_stats cs ON ors.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.product_id END) AS on_sale_product_count,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount END), 2) AS total_actual_raise,
    COUNT(pce.record_id) AS product_conduct_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pce.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 pce
    ON pce.institution_id = i.institution_id
    AND pce.exception_flag = 1
LEFT JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
    AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pce.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise DESC;

WITH asset_agg AS (
    SELECT
        originator_institution_id AS institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS asset_count,
        ROUND(SUM(issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount
    FROM managed_asset
    GROUP BY originator_institution_id
),
custody_agg AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_record_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_exception_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount
    FROM custody_operation_event_v3
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    a.asset_count,
    a.total_issued_amount,
    c.active_record_count,
    c.exception_amount
FROM asset_agg a
JOIN custody_agg c ON a.institution_id = c.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE c.active_exception_count >= 2
ORDER BY a.total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
